verses.html: 1 In those days the crowd once again became very large, and they had nothing to eat. Jesus called the disciples to Him and said,
verses.text: 1 In those days the crowd once again became very large, and they had nothing to eat. Jesus called the disciples to Him and said,

verses.html: 2 “I have compassion for this crowd, because they have already been with Me three days and have nothing to eat.
verses.text: 2 “I have compassion for this crowd, because they have already been with Me three days and have nothing to eat.

verses.html: 3 If I send them home hungry, they will faint along the way. For some of them have come a great distance.”
verses.text: 3 If I send them home hungry, they will faint along the way. For some of them have come a great distance.”

verses.html: 4 His disciples replied, “Where in this desolate place could anyone find enough bread to feed all these people?”
verses.text: 4 His disciples replied, “Where in this desolate place could anyone find enough bread to feed all these people?”

verses.html: 5 “How many loaves do you have?” Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied.
verses.text: 5 “How many loaves do you have?” Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied.

verses.html: 6 And He instructed the crowd to sit down on the ground. Then He took the seven loaves, gave thanks and broke them, and gave them to His disciples to set before the people. And they distributed them to the crowd.
verses.text: 6 And He instructed the crowd to sit down on the ground. Then He took the seven loaves, gave thanks and broke them, and gave them to His disciples to set before the people. And they distributed them to the crowd.

verses.html: 7 They also had a few small fish, and Jesus blessed them and ordered that these be set before them as well.
verses.text: 7 They also had a few small fish, and Jesus blessed them and ordered that these be set before them as well.

verses.html: 8 The people ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
verses.text: 8 The people ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

verses.html: 9 And about four thousand men were present. And when Jesus had dismissed the crowd,
verses.text: 9 And about four thousand men were present. And when Jesus had dismissed the crowd,

verses.html: 10 He immediately got into the boat with His disciples and went to the district of Dalmanutha.
verses.text: 10 He immediately got into the boat with His disciples and went to the district of Dalmanutha.

verses.html: 1 In those days, there again being a great crowd, and not having anything {that} they might eat, having summoned his disciples, he says to them,
verses.text: 1 In those days, there again being a great crowd, and not having anything {that} they might eat, having summoned his disciples, he says to them,

verses.html: 2 “I have compassion on the crowd because they are remaining with me already three days and do not have anything {that} they might eat.
verses.text: 2 “I have compassion on the crowd because they are remaining with me already three days and do not have anything {that} they might eat.

verses.html: 3 And if I would send them away to their home hungry, they will faint on the way, and some of them have come from far way.”
verses.text: 3 And if I would send them away to their home hungry, they will faint on the way, and some of them have come from far way.”

verses.html: 4 And his disciples answered him, “From where will anyone be able to satisfy these {people} with loaves here in a desolate place?”
verses.text: 4 And his disciples answered him, “From where will anyone be able to satisfy these {people} with loaves here in a desolate place?”

verses.html: 5 And he asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” And they said, “Seven.”
verses.text: 5 And he asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” And they said, “Seven.”

verses.html: 6 And he commands the crowd to recline on the ground, and having taken the seven loaves, having given thanks, he broke {them} and was giving {them} to his disciples so that they might set {them} before {them}, and they set {them} before the crowd.
verses.text: 6 And he commands the crowd to recline on the ground, and having taken the seven loaves, having given thanks, he broke {them} and was giving {them} to his disciples so that they might set {them} before {them}, and they set {them} before the crowd.

verses.html: 7 And they had a few small fish, and having blessed them, he said to set these also before {them}.
verses.text: 7 And they had a few small fish, and having blessed them, he said to set these also before {them}.

verses.html: 8 And they ate and were satisfied, and they took up the remaining of the broken pieces—seven baskets.
verses.text: 8 And they ate and were satisfied, and they took up the remaining of the broken pieces—seven baskets.

verses.html: 9 Now there were about 4, 000, and he sent them away.
verses.text: 9 Now there were about 4, 000, and he sent them away.

verses.html: 10 And immediately, having gotten into the boat with his disciples, he went into the regions of Dalmanutha.
verses.text: 10 And immediately, having gotten into the boat with his disciples, he went into the regions of Dalmanutha.

verses.html: 1 Sometime later, there was again a large group of people {near Jesus}, and they did not have any food to eat. So, Jesus told his apprentices to come to him. He told them,
verses.text: 1 Sometime later, there was again a large group of people {near Jesus}, and they did not have any food to eat. So, Jesus told his apprentices to come to him. He told them,

verses.html: 2 “I pity the large group of people. They have already spent three days with me, and they do not have any food to eat.
verses.text: 2 “I pity the large group of people. They have already spent three days with me, and they do not have any food to eat.

verses.html: 3 Further, suppose that I tell them to go home while they are hungry. Some of them live far away from here. They would pass out while they are walking home.”
verses.text: 3 Further, suppose that I tell them to go home while they are hungry. Some of them live far away from here. They would pass out while they are walking home.”

verses.html: 4 His apprentices replied, “In this place where no one lives, no one has enough food for these people to have enough to eat!”
verses.text: 4 His apprentices replied, “In this place where no one lives, no one has enough food for these people to have enough to eat!”

verses.html: 5 Then Jesus asked them, “How many loaves of bread do you have with you?” They replied, “We have with us seven loaves of bread.”
verses.text: 5 Then Jesus asked them, “How many loaves of bread do you have with you?” They replied, “We have with us seven loaves of bread.”

verses.html: 6 Then Jesus told the large group of people to sit down on the ground. He picked up the seven loaves of bread. Then he thanked God for the food. After that, he tore the bread into pieces and gave the pieces to his apprentices. That way, they could serve them to the large group of people, which they did.
verses.text: 6 Then Jesus told the large group of people to sit down on the ground. He picked up the seven loaves of bread. Then he thanked God for the food. After that, he tore the bread into pieces and gave the pieces to his apprentices. That way, they could serve them to the large group of people, which they did.

verses.html: 7 The apprentices also had some little fish. So, Jesus thanked God for these fish and told the apprentices to serve them too {to the large group of people}.
verses.text: 7 The apprentices also had some little fish. So, Jesus thanked God for these fish and told the apprentices to serve them too {to the large group of people}.

verses.html: 8 The people ate {the food}, and they had enough to eat. Then the apprentices gathered the food that was left. {They filled} seven large containers!
verses.text: 8 The people ate {the food}, and they had enough to eat. Then the apprentices gathered the food that was left. {They filled} seven large containers!

verses.html: 9 About 4, 000 people were there. Then Jesus told them to go home.
verses.text: 9 About 4, 000 people were there. Then Jesus told them to go home.

verses.html: 10 As soon as {he told them that}, Jesus and his apprentices climbed into a boat. They sailed to the region of Dalmanutha.
verses.text: 10 As soon as {he told them that}, Jesus and his apprentices climbed into a boat. They sailed to the region of Dalmanutha.

verses.html: 1 In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them,
verses.text: 1 In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them,

verses.html: 2 “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days and have nothing to eat.
verses.text: 2 “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days and have nothing to eat.

verses.html: 3 If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”
verses.text: 3 If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”

verses.html: 4 His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”
verses.text: 4 His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”

verses.html: 5 He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”
verses.text: 5 He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”

verses.html: 6 He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.
verses.text: 6 He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.

verses.html: 7 They also had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.
verses.text: 7 They also had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.

verses.html: 8 They ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.
verses.text: 8 They ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

verses.html: 9 Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.
verses.text: 9 Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.

verses.html: 10 Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples and came into the region of Dalmanutha.
verses.text: 10 Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples and came into the region of Dalmanutha.
